vb_textbox.text: Pick a gnome at random at first if it is 4 or 5 mushrooms or more keep picking the gnome with the same hat until the score drops then switch to the gnome with the other hat. The colours of the hat doesnt seem to make much difference. If you loose track of which gnome you are picking just pick at random to find a good scoring gnome. Remember to chose a gnome quickly and press the space bar when the basket appears.
